### 💰 Fund This Feature via Opire
Commercial robotics teams and community backers can accelerate development and sponsor this feature by posting a bounty comment:
```text
@opire /bounty $amount
```
*(Example: `@opire /bounty $250` or `@opire /bounty $500`)*
